correctness.rationale: The exact positive-weight cyclic trace equations reduce to an alternating product closure condition. K+lambda B is SPD and converges variationally to the restriction of K to ker B, giving an if-and-only-if all-load Dirichlet criterion. On the single Q1 square, exact integration yields K v=(2/3)v, F=v/36, det C_epsilon=epsilon/4, C_0 v=0, B_exact v=v/3. Left/right null projections yield the sharp lambda epsilon^2 window and coefficient 1/(24+9 tau), while positive smallest singular value establishes the infinity endpoint. The independent exact symbolic calculation in verify.py passed 64 assertions; no infinite claim is based solely on finite checks.

value.rationale: One-point Robin face quadrature satisfies first-degree algebraic precision on affine traces but can annihilate a nonzero boundary mode, yielding a discrete Dirichlet limit failure invisible to finite-penalty positive-definiteness. The cycle criterion is complete and useful for diagnostic mesh/quad design, while the explicit 1/sqrt(lambda) displacement scale supplies a nontrivial quantitative sensitivity boundary. No claim of universal method failure or refinement-rate breakdown is made.
